note: Found by the derived calls oracle while closing `references`: `nsAt` returns "" for a file with no `ns` form, so 70 dependency edges across the corpus were published as `references||…` - a relationship with only one end, which is exactly what the 'all extracted, resolved and emitted' contract exists to prevent. The analyzer attributes those to Clojure's default namespace, `user`. CLJ-D47 taught exactly this fallback to the `calls` derivation; the two halves having drifted apart is the same lesson as the alias tables, where one language fact was re-derived in four places and each copy drifted differently. Pinned with no `ns` form at all, because that is the smallest instance and is not contrived - scratch files and REPL pastes routinely omit one.
